verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms the Snyk CLI can be run in CI/CD pipelines and produces test reports on vulnerabilities (snyk-gh-3, snyk-gh-4, snyk-gh-5), and Snyk Open Source explicitly supports PR-based workflows (snyk-docs-21), supporting the core 'scan in CI on PRs' story. However, the evidence never explicitly documents exit-code behavior or build-failing thresholds for new findings, and community feedback describes CI integration as a 'challenging integration that ultimately creates very low value' (snyk-comm-8), raising doubts about smooth CI gating in practice. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit-code/build-fail behavior on new findings, and independent confirmation that CI gating works reliably as claimed.
